title: Hold a smoking product licence
what: Sell smoking products only under a smoking product licence (or as an employee of a licensee).

sources.title: Public Health Act 1997 (Tas)
sources.quote: A person must not sell a smoking product unless – (a) [Section 74A Amended by No. 42 of 2017, s. 20, Applied:29 Nov 2017] the person is authorised by a smoking product licence to sell the smoking product;
